events.body:
## Upgrade vulnerable dependencies

This PR upgrades **2** packages in `authkit` with known security advisories, each to the release that fixes the most of them while being at least 7 days old (brand-new releases are where supply-chain attacks land).

| Package | From | To | Released | Fixes | Still open |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PyJWT` | 1.7.1 | **2.14.0** | 43 days ago | [CVE-2026-101917](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-101917), [CVE-2026-32597](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-32597), [CVE-2026-102267](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-102267), [CVE-2026-102268](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-102268), [CVE-2022-29217](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-29217), [CVE-2026-102269](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-102269) and 6 more | - |
| `requests` | 2.31.0 | **2.33.0** | 213 days ago | [CVE-2024-47081](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-47081), [CVE-2024-35195](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-35195), [CVE-2026-25645](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-25645) | - |

### Tests

| | Result |
|---|---|
| Before the upgrade | ✅ 5 passed, 10 warnings in 0.16s |
| After the version bump | ❌ 4 failed, 1 passed, 4 warnings in 0.23s |
| After OpenPort's fix 1 | ❌ 2 failed, 3 passed, 4 warnings in 0.19s |
| After OpenPort's fix 2 | ✅ 5 passed, 8 warnings in 0.16s |

### Code changes

The upgrade broke the tests, so Nemotron Super changed the application code (never the tests):

- `authkit/tokens.py`: In PyJWT 2.0 and above, jwt.encode returns a string (not bytes), so the .decode('utf-8') call is unnecessary and causes an AttributeError. Based on: [Welcome to PyJWT — PyJWT 2.14.0 documentation](https://pyjwt.readthedocs.io), [Releases · jpadilla/pyjwt · GitHub](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/releases).
- `authkit/tokens.py`: PyJWT 2.0+ requires the algorithms argument for decode() when verifying signatures unless using a PyJWT key; the fix adds the HS256 algorithm list to match the issue function. Based on: [Changelog — PyJWT 2.15.1 documentation](https://pyjwt.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html).

---
Opened by OpenPort. Never auto-merged: review the changes and the test results above.

-    return token.decode("utf-8")
